submission.bindingBasis: The owner reports ownerChanged=true: Workspace source identity advanced after planning. The planning evidence (sourceStateDigest sha256:e5d8... and head 4e6ce63...) may no longer be accurate. The owner contract for workspace.close allows either an unbound close or a compare-and-close against one exact expectedSourceStateDigest. Since the source advanced, acting with the planning-time digest as a binding would risk a mismatched-digest not_committed failure, and acting unbound would risk closing a Workspace whose state has diverged from what was reviewed and judged ready to close. Workspace.get can project currentHeadRevision and exact sourceStateDigest; reobserving first lets me decide between compare-and-close on the current digest, an unbound close, or HOLD based on the actual advanced state.
submission.rationale: Planning-time evidence is stale: the owner explicitly reports that Workspace source identity advanced (ownerChanged=true). The consequence is a close that releases local materialization, which is destructive to the current state. Closing against the stale planning digest would fail compare-and-close (mismatch => not_committed); closing unbound would release a state that was never reviewed. Reobserve via workspace.get to obtain currentHeadRevision and exact sourceStateDigest, then decide between compare-and-close on the current digest, unbound close, or HOLD. This preserves useful progress and avoids acting on stale evidence for a materialization-releasing consequence.
